status: experimental; fixed parameters before historical comparison
evaluation_policy: Compare fixed candidate and baseline on identical prior-selected players, retaining zero outcomes. Report early-season and full-window point MAE, workload error, and week-level differences. Do not tune on 2024 or 2025. Do not claim statistical significance or calibrated uncertainty from these fixed-weight experiments.
limitations: Prior strengths are transparent heuristics, not fitted optimal weights.
No verified current injury feed, snap/routes, red-zone locations, coaching, weather, or designed-run/scramble split.
Future workload is held at the current sample-aware role estimate; only schedule and fading defensive effects vary by future week.
Previous-season defensive information is discounted for continuity uncertainty; personnel continuity is not explicitly modeled.
Players with no current-season usage are not covered; players without prior-season history lack a player-specific volume prior.
Historical data may include subsequent stat corrections.
